# `company.memorized_transaction_revisions`

Immutable versions of a memorized transaction: the command input and the schedule it captured.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with template_id + id | — | — | Immutable revision of one memorized transaction. |
| `template_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with template_id + id, unique with template_id + version | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.template_id, memorized_transactions.id | Template this revision belongs to. |
| `version` | BIGINT | no | — | unique with template_id + version | — | — | Version of the template this revision recorded. |
| `previous_revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | memorized_transaction_revisions.id | Revision this one supersedes; null on the first. |
| `command` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | Registered create or post command captured by this revision. |
| `payload` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Canonical validated input of that command, as a JSON object, with references stored as stable ids. |
| `payload_hash` | VARCHAR(64) | no | — | — | — | — | SHA-256 of the canonical payload, so an unchanged edit is visible as unchanged. |
| `schedule_snapshot` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | JSON object of the schedule and mode this revision captured. |
| `reference_schema` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Whether the command declares reference paths (declared) or none are declared (none). |
